verdict.rationale: The filing page states up front that you must register for and log into the eSystems portal before you can reach Webfile. The probe confirms Webfile sits behind an authenticated eSystems session. Beyond that single account-registration statement, the pack does not spell out which credentials or identity-proofing steps a founder will meet. Missing for 10: an itemized pre-start list of required credentials (e.g., account or Webfile numbers), a description of identity-proofing or verification steps, and independent confirmation that no further walls appear mid-flow.
